svg.aria-label: Left: the error of value iteration in the sup norm, on a log scale, against the number of sweeps. For Jack's car rental the error falls in a straight line parallel to the dashed contraction bound gamma to the k times the size of V star, with gamma 0.9. For the gridworld with gamma 0.99 it falls much faster than the bound, about a factor 0.45 per sweep, because episodes end. Right: the optimal policy of Jack's car rental as a 21 by 21 grid, cars at location 1 on the vertical axis and at location 2 on the horizontal; up to 5 cars move from location 1 to 2 when location 1 is full and location 2 nearly empty, and up to 4 move back when location 1 is nearly empty
svg.text: optimal moves: + from 1 to 2, − from 2 to 1
